images.subject: Science
images.description: A duplicated chromosome: two sister chromatids joined at the centromere
images.alt: A duplicated chromosome shaped like an X: two identical sister chromatids joined at the centromere

provenance.prompt:
A single duplicated chromosome in the classic X shape: two identical sister chromatids (one blue, one teal, mirrored) crossing and joined at one small centromere drawn in the orange accent. Front view, centred, vertical.

Style: Flat vector educational illustration for children aged 9 to 15. Clean even outlines, flat fills, white background, plenty of empty margin around the subject. Palette: blues and teals (#7BAFD4 to #4A9AA8 with darker outlines of the same hue) plus exactly one warm orange accent (#F5A04A) used for the single most important part. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows with text, no gradients, no drop shadows, no 3D rendering, no photographic texture.
Avoid: text, letters, digits, captions, watermark, signature, gradient, shadow, 3D, photo, cartoon face, extra limbs.
provenance.prompt_note: the recipe prompt, written to describe the supplied image; the original generation prompt is not known

review.anchors: session vision review: two mirrored chromatids, four rounded arms of similar length, one orange centromere at the junction; colours run diagonally (flagged for a teacher glance); pins checked by rendering
